description: A Mica window: your desktop picture frosted to a wash of color under a dense graphite tint, the content one step lighter than the frame.

files.themes/glass-mica.json:
// Glass: mica. A Mica window: your own desktop picture behind the window, frosted once into a
// soft wash of its colors, under a dense graphite tint, with the content one step lighter than the
// frame. Nothing behind the window shows as shapes, only as color (the glass lab's acrylic recipe,
// which measured 12:1 and up for text over busy backgrounds).
// Frosted over a picture blurs the picture, not the live desktop (WindowBackdrop.artBlurRadius).
{
  "name": "Glass: mica",
  "description": "Mica: your desktop picture frosted to a wash of color under graphite, content a step lighter.",

  "appearance.theme": "Apple System Colors",
  "colors": { "background": "#1f2023", "foreground": "#ecedef", "selection": "#3a3d44", "accent": "#a5b4fc" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The window: the desktop picture, frosted, a dense tint that keeps only its color.
  "appearance.background": "desktop",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "frosted",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.8,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.2,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // The frame: sidebar and tab strip a darker graphite that lets the wash through.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#18191b",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.72,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#18191b",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 0.78,

  // The content: one step lighter and almost solid.
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#1f2023",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.92,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#1f2023",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.92,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#1f2023",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.82,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#1f2023",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 0.92,

  "browser.omnibar.glass": "regular",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTint": "background",
  "browser.omnibar.glassTintStrength": 0.5,

  // Outlined cards and trays on the Mac's own materials.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "card-outlined",
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 0.5,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "tray"
}
